content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 7.7 (p0032) is the sole Customer-payable liquidated damages provision — 15% of annual Fees per week for an invoice ten days overdue. That is not an early-termination fee and is uncapped, so it fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory. Service credits and the § 27 "without penalty" termination right run in our favour and were not flagged; § 9.4 imposes only accrued Fees on early termination, so no early-termination fee cap was needed. Redline validated at the preferred level: § 7.7 is replaced with an express statement that Customer owes no liquidated damages or penalties, with no dangling cross-references left behind.
